newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds give up gains as U.S. market slips.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds give up gains as U.S. market slips.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Swiss bonds ended lower, giving up early gains as U.S. bonds faltered. The long end held in a narrow range.
Both bonds and EuroSwiss futures ended near day's lows.
* June Conf ends down eight basis points at 120.29
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yields 4.484 pct vs 3.48 pct.
